pattern: Presentational CSS layout (no ARIA widget pattern). Dividers follow HTML <hr> and the WAI-ARIA separator role (non-focusable).

roles.role: none added (the consumer element keeps its own semantics)

aria.value: The label text (separator children are presentational)

keyboard.action: Not applicable: layout primitives and dividers are not focusable. Focus follows the source order of the consumer's content, including under aui-flex--reverse.

focus: Not focusable. Layout never changes the DOM order, so reading and focus order stay in source order.
notes: Auto-fit grids and wrapping flex rows support 320 CSS px reflow (WCAG 1.4.10).
Gaps use rem-based tokens, so spacing scales with user text-size and text-spacing settings.
Row-reverse only changes visual order; avoid it where order carries meaning (WCAG 1.3.2).
knownCaveats: Screen readers differ in whether they announce separators and their labels; labelled dividers are supplementary, not structural.
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
